en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with a distinctive rose window and a campanile (bell tower) topped by an onion-shaped dome. In front of the church is an ornate fountain in a wide public square. The architecture suggests medieval or early Renaissance influences. There is minor wear and some foxing on the postcard, but no visible text.
